entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah, VeloFit agent ID 303. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return these useless cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable!

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

What kind of a question is that? They're junk! I put the cleats on, went for one ride, and my feet are covered in blisters. I can barely walk! This is a defective product and I want a refund immediately.
Oh, that sounds incredibly painful, and I sincerely apologize for that experience. Getting blisters is certainly not what we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order.

You'd better! Because if I don't get my money back, I'm going to leave a review on every single website and forum about how your garbage cycling shoes injure people. This is ridiculous. Get me your supervisor!

I understand your frustration, and there's no need to speak with a supervisor. I am empowered to resolve this for you right now. I see here that you received the shoes 9 days ago. Our standard return policy for apparel and shoes is 10 days, so you are unfortunately outside the window to send them back for a full refund.
Wait, so you're actually going to give me a full refund? No restocking fee or other nonsense?

That's correct. A complete, 100% refund to your original payment method. I am generating a pre-paid return shipping label for you right now and will email it to the address on file. You can just print that out, package the shoes, and drop them off with the carrier.
Okay... well... that's what I wanted. I'll look for the email then.

I've just sent it. You should receive it in the next few minutes. Once our warehouse scans the return, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I do hope we can provide you with a better experience in the future. Have a good day.
